drafts.title: Accounting and Finance Management
drafts.hero: Girne American University lists Accounting and Finance Management as an English-taught undergraduate subject with a 4-year Accounting-department course grid. The published panel does not confirm the certificate title or whether this is separate from GAU's BSc Accounting; check with the university.
overview: GAU's Turkish programme page is headed Muhasebe ve Finans Yönetimi (Accounting and Finance Management). Its internal panel identifies the Accounting department in the School of Applied Social Sciences, English-language teaching and a 4-year undergraduate route. The page describes accounting, taxation, audit and financial analysis alongside economics, statistics and computer applications.

The published table runs from Year 1 to Year 4. GAU's English directory groups this subject under a different faculty, while a separate department page names a BSc in Accounting. The university has not explained how those titles and units relate. Confirm the certificate title and applicable curriculum before presenting this as a distinct BSc.

drafts.title: Human Resources Management
drafts.hero: Girne American University lists Human Resources Management as a 4-year English-taught undergraduate course. Its Turkish programme page names the subject and department but gives no course list, learning outcomes or BSc award statement. Confirm the award and remaining details with GAU.
overview: GAU's Turkish programme panel names Human Resources Management within its Business Faculty and identifies a 4-year undergraduate route taught in English. The 2026–27 Turkish admissions table also lists an English-language Human Resources Management intake.

The programme page does not publish an HR-specific curriculum, degree certificate title or career information. A Human Resource Management module in GAU's Business Management degree is not evidence of this course's content. Obtain the award specification and entry terms directly from GAU before preparing a public page.

drafts.title: BA Global Business (Level 9)
drafts.hero: UWS lists BA Global Business (Level 9) with ICBS, a Sri Lankan college with campuses in Colombo and Kandy. The list does not confirm this course's teaching site, syllabus, duration, mode or fee, nor call it an Honours award. Seek the exact specification before publication.
overview: The University of the West of Scotland lists BA Global Business (Level 9) among the programmes offered with Imperial College of Business Studies in Sri Lanka. The same UWS list separately names BA (Hons) International Business & Finance, which is a different qualification.

UWS does not supply a Global Business syllabus, duration, delivery arrangement, admissions requirements or fee on that partner listing. The Level 9 BA must not be presented as the client-listed BA (Hons) in Global Business without university confirmation.
